Each tent is a cylinder of base radius $6 \text{ m}$ and height $3 \text{ m}$, surmounted by a cone of the same radius and height $8 \text{ m}$. The floor is not made of canvas. If canvas costs ₹ $80$ per m$^{2}$, find the amount each NGO pays. (Use $\pi = 3.14$.)

A travelling circus puts up a tent whose lower part is a cylinder of radius $21 \text{ m}$ and height $4 \text{ m}$, topped by a cone of the same radius. The top of the tent is $24 \text{ m}$ above the ground. The ground inside is covered with mats, and the cylindrical and conical surfaces are made of canvas. (Use $\pi = \frac{22}{7}$.)
